title: Approve the main screen composition
question: Three layouts in the Catalogue Sleeve world. Which should the build follow? Use steer to combine (e.g. '2, with 3's recording plot while a take renders').

options.label: Plot leads
options.thesis: The last song's pulse plot owns the top half; lyrics sit small beneath.
options.viewport: Catalogue number, a large stacked-line plot, then style and lyrics in small caps, colour-code strip at the foot.
options.risk: Writing is secondary, which contradicts 'writing leads'.

options.label: Writing leads
options.thesis: The lyric sheet is the screen; one framed Record button with the next catalogue number.
options.viewport: Style line, large lyrics with a proportional section rail in the margin, RECORD LRS-015 with a red block, settings etched in one grey line beneath.
options.risk: Quietest of the three; the plot only appears once a song exists.

options.label: Take in progress
options.thesis: A polar plot of the take being cut sits above the lyrics; the catalogue index runs along the bottom.
options.viewport: Circular plot with progress arc, RECORDING · LRS-015 · 2:14/4:00, style and lyrics, numbered index 012–015 with the current one framed red.
options.risk: Busier; the plot competes with writing when idle.
